chose: While our judgment about hardware, and the software infrastructure around it, is naive, nothing is paid for: no rental, no purchase, no paid tier. Every step that costs money comes last in its story and is gated behind a measured judgment gate: the owner's own predictions, made before seeing results, hold against real measurements. Defining that measure and recognising when it is met is part of the story (#3309).
undo: A new owner call that moves this one, naming the gate that was met or the reason to spend before it.
